requirements.quote: This form must be submitted with any bid, proposal, or proposed negotiated contract or within a reasonable time thereafter, but prior to contract award.
requirements.text: Submit the M/WBE Subcontractor Utilization Plan form with the bid or proposal before contract award.

requirements.quote: This Utilization Plan must contain a detailed description of the supplies and/or services to be provided by each certified Minority and Women-owned Business Enterprise (M/WBE) subcontractor under the contract.
requirements.text: Include detailed descriptions of supplies/services provided by each M/WBE subcontractor.
Attach extra sheets if more space is needed.

requirements.quote: Submission of this form constitutes the Offeror's acknowledgement and agreement to comply with the M/WBE requirements set forth under NYS Executive Law, Article 15-A, 5 NYCRR Part 143, and the above-referenced solicitation.
requirements.text: Submitting the form acknowledges compliance with NYS M/WBE requirements.
